messages:
incident-bot: Pager: PROD inference runtime spike in eu-west-2 (inference-pool-eu-west-2a). 5xx rate ~18% over last 2m for /v1/generate. Pager: ben (on-call)

ben (on-call): I'm on it. starting triage. @maria can you join?

maria (sre): joining. I see node evictions + GPU OOMs on inference-runner-7c9f. kernel coredump alerts fired. CPU looks fine, GPU memory saturated.

priya (lead eng): multiple SIGSEGVs in model-runner process confirmed. stack samples point to quant_attention kernel. tagging @alex for runtime traces.

alex (runtime): pulling logs now. last crash backtrace (sanitized):

```
#0  0x7f6a2... in quant_attention_execute at quant_kernel.c:412
#1  0x7f6a3... in model_step at runner.c:998
#2  0x5578... in main at main.c:210
```

alex (runtime): we're also seeing repeated GPU OOMs right before segfaults. looks like kvcache growth + continuous batching bursts.

ben (on-call): what's the customer impact? @raj

raj (support): ACME-AI (tenant: acme-ai) seeing ~40% 5xx on their requests since ~12:02 UTC. multiple support tickets from their SREs. they are pinned to model "mistral-22b-quant" v3.

maria (sre): immediate mitigation: enable fallback routing to dedicated pool eu-west-2b and reduce batch_size to 1 for mistral-22b-quant. i'll trigger reroute now.

ops-bot: Automated action: traffic reroute executed -> dest: dedicated-eu-west-2b for /v1/generate. 85% of new requests shifted. command: `/ops reroute --route=/v1/generate --dest=dedicated-eu-west-2b --percent=85` :white_check_mark: 

priya (lead eng): we should also rollback yesterday's quantization kernel patch (commit ad3f6) if errors persist. fallback to float kernels as plan B.

alex (runtime): coredump uploaded to s3://redwood-infra/coredumps/4998841122/ and debug snapshot created. command used: `gdb --batch -ex "thread apply all bt full" --core core.1234 /usr/bin/model-runner > /tmp/stack.txt`

ben (on-call): error rate dropping to ~4.2% after reroute. monitoring closely.

maria (sre): rolling restart for inference-runner-7c9f to clear potential kvcache leak: drain -> delete -> recreate.

ops-bot: Restart triggered: node inference-runner-7c9f replaced with inference-runner-8e2d. pod healthchecks: passing. :rocket:

raj (support): ACME-AI update: errors decreasing, tickets updated, CS/AE notified.

priya (lead eng): action items documented: 1) deep-dive quant_kernel.c:412 crash path; 2) add kvcache caps and eviction policy; 3) temporary model pin to smaller variant for high-traffic tenants. I'll open tasks and link the PRs.

ben (on-call): closing update: route error rate now ~0.9%, ACME-AI at ~1.2%. incident created P0-4998841122 and assigned to eng-runtime for postmortem. great work everyone. :thumbsup:

incident-bot: Incident P0-4998841122 created (severity P0). Pager cleared.
